NOTE","groupId":"c0ba6f45-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The Asian American Studies major promotes the study of the histories, contemporary realities, and diverse experiences of Asian and Pacific Islander Americans. The BA program in Asian American Studies provides a general introduction for students who anticipate advanced work at the graduate level or careers in research, public service, and community work related to Asian and Pacific Islander Americans.


Listed below are the lower division preparation courses for the major.


To be considered for this major, you must complete a minimum of one course from the required major preparatory section listed below by the end of spring before transfer:

  • One lower division Asian American Studies course that focuses on Asian Americans or Ethnic Studies.

All courses must be taken for a letter grade.


For more information regarding this major and UCLA's transfer selection process, visit https://asianam.ucla.edu and https://admission.ucla.edu.


PLEASE NOTE: the community college courses listed below have been approved to satisfy preparation for this major at UCLA, but they may not be exact equivalents of the UCLA courses listed.
